pre_update_notes: Note for installs currently on 1.0.16: 1.0.17 was never published as a standalone release (its work is folded into this one, along with everything since) — this release updates directly from 1.0.16, no intermediate hop needed. Every new toggleable feature (Buy Now, the new product-detail-page sections, per-product reviews, etc.) ships OFF/disabled by default — review and opt in from Settings at your own pace after updating. The admin Settings area has been reorganized into fewer, tabbed pages; every old settings URL still works and 301s straight to its new location, so no bookmark or saved link breaks.
post_update_notes: A large batch: a redesigned product detail page (new gallery, spec ledger, vehicle-fitment table, customer reviews, optional Buy Now flow), a modernized SEO Health Dashboard with several new reports (Search Console analytics, on-page audit, Core Web Vitals trend), an extensive SEO/structured-data/redirects/sitemap pass, an 8-phase reorganization of the entire admin Settings area (including a new searchable Site Copy Library for editing storefront text), and a comprehensive end-to-end test suite that found and fixed several real bugs along the way — most importantly, customer order-tracking links have been broken for every order on every carrier since the carriers were first configured (now fixed), admin bell notifications for new orders/refunds were completely silent, the address book and Create Customer/Create Order admin forms were unusable, and the mobile site overflowed off-screen on every page in German/Lithuanian/French/Spanish (not English). Every migration applies automatically; every new behavior defaults to matching what the site already did. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list.
